project_type: consulting assessment framework and report generation system for ecommerce product discovery and information retrieval evaluation
mission_phase: Generation 8 - Local School PTA Opportunity Executive Brief

mission_critical_workflows.required_outcome: Evaluator can assess product discovery experiences consistently across search, autocomplete, browse, filters, recommendations, mobile, and realistic journeys.
Each finding includes observation, evidence, severity, customer impact, business impact, and recommendation.
The Boxercraft assessment identifies Boxercraft-specific opportunities from rendered public retail and public wholesale evidence while recording access limits and avoiding overfit to one retailer.
Report and deck present key findings, strengths, weaknesses, revenue-impacting opportunities, recommended next steps, scorecard, and opportunity matrix in business language.

mission_critical_workflows.workflow: Produce local school buyer opportunity brief
mission_critical_workflows.required_outcome: A concise Northvalley PDF explains why nearby PTA buyers may not choose Boxercraft, using evidence-backed local visibility, search, autocomplete, browse, and customer-journey pain points while preserving source limitations.
Generated PDFs compile, contain expected text, render nonblank pages, and show no obvious overlap in spot-checked pages.

tools_or_methods: GEN-008 local school opportunity evidence summary
selected_validations.reason: Validates that the framework produces evidence-backed product discovery findings and that the Boxercraft case includes normalization, all-node browse/search/autocomplete parity, browse-routing, competitor pricing/discovery evidence, and the focused local school PTA executive brief.

tools_or_methods: JSON parse checks for Boxercraft assessment, browser evidence, and GEN-004 normalization evidence
selected_validations.reason: The assessment data and generated Northvalley PDF sources must be reproducible and structurally sound.
After meaningful code changes or two clean Validation Gate passes, project work must be submitted to GitHub and production parity must be recorded when applicable.

tools_or_methods: local school PTA report readability review
selected_validations.reason: Business leaders must be able to understand the assessment without technical search implementation knowledge.
PDF output is now selected, so client-facing layout quality must be validated for the draft report and deck.
The mission requires broad coverage across discovery mechanisms and explicit separation of public evidence from unavailable or unvalidated surfaces.

tools_or_methods: GEN-008 local school opportunity brief evidence
selected_validations.reason: The framework's value depends on observed ecommerce behavior, not only internal data structures.

coverage_targets.high_priority_mission_objectives: 90%+ with explicit deferral for independent evaluator calibration
coverage_targets.assessment_areas: 100% represented in the assessment; rendered browser validation completed for search, autocomplete, filters, recommendations, mobile, zero-result pages, and public wholesale search; GEN-004 normalization matrix completed for search, autocomplete, browse routing, UCLA/Bruins priority terms, team aliases, and public wholesale SKU variants; GEN-006 competitor benchmark completed for public pricing, catalog search, rendered search/autocomplete samples, and browse evidence; GEN-007 all-node browse/search/autocomplete parity completed for public collection nodes; GEN-008 local school PTA brief completed from ecommerce evidence plus user-provided website benchmark; authenticated wholesale remains access-limited
coverage_targets.output_artifacts: 100% for draft executive report, detailed findings, scorecard, opportunity matrix, presentation deck, GEN-003 browser evidence, GEN-004 normalization evidence, GEN-006 competitor benchmark evidence, GEN-007 browse-node parity evidence, and GEN-008 local school PTA opportunity PDF/evidence summary
coverage_targets.finding_traceability: 100% of report findings must trace to evidence, stakeholder-context assumption, or explicit unavailable-data note
